name: Solberg-Maru ShiftLayer Zip-Cuff Thermal Glove — Pair
description: Fingerless thermal gloves with zip-on full-finger caps that convert them from dexterous work gloves to full cold-weather hand cover in one motion. Slate blue synthetic leather palm with a knit thermal back panel; the zip-on caps are stored rolled at the wrist when not in use. Fits over standard chrome hand augmentation with an elasticated chrome-knuckle gusset.
functionality: Zip-on full-finger caps for cold conversion; chrome-knuckle elasticated gusset for aug fit; caps stow at wrist.
what_it_says: You need your hands free to work but you're not freezing your fingers off waiting for the temperature to make up its mind.
worn_by: data entry workers with chrome hands
story_hooks: The zip caps on the right glove are a different color than the left — a mismatched replacement that suggests the originals were lost in a hurry.
The chrome-gusset spec matches a Vansen AugMount fitting exactly, suggesting these were designed in tandem with someone else's product line.

physical_description.visual_profile: Sleek fingerless gloves with a technical, modular aesthetic. Slate blue leather palms contrast with charcoal knit backs. Compact rolled finger-caps sit at the wrist like armored bracelets, ready for deployment. The design reads as practical and augmentation-aware—clean lines, minimal excess.
physical_description.fit: Snug over the hand and wrist with elasticated chrome-knuckle gussets that accommodate both organic and synthetic fingers. The rolled caps add no bulk when stowed. Designed for precision grip without compromising dexterity.
physical_description.primary_material: Slate blue synthetic leather palm (durability and grip); charcoal thermal knit back panel (heat retention); reinforced chrome-elasticated gussets at knuckles
physical_description.texture: Smooth, treated synthetic leather on palm with slight texture for grip; soft, dense thermal knit on back; elasticated gussets feel firm and structured
physical_description.color_scheme: Slate blue synthetic leather contrasted with charcoal thermal knit; chrome accents at knuckles; neutral grey-blue palette with industrial metallic highlights
physical_description.closures: Dual micro-zippers on rolled caps (one per glove) for secure attachment; elasticated wrist opening with chrome-reinforced gusset system
distinctive_features: Modular zip-on/off full-finger caps stored rolled at wrist
Chrome-knuckle elasticated gussets designed to fit over cybernetic hand augmentations
Fingerless design prioritizes tactile work while thermal caps provide cold-weather conversion
Solberg-Maru branding embossed on palm in matte finish
Micro-zip design minimizes snag risk in industrial environments
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 functional luxury. Premium materials and augmentation-aware design suggest corpo or skilled trade access, but the modular, practical focus avoids tier-1 ostentation.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by augmented technicians, field engineers, and corpo field operatives. Signals technical competence and investment in reliable gear. The augmentation accommodation marks wearer as either cybernetically enhanced or regularly working alongside augmented colleagues.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; develops scuffing on leather palms and slight fraying at knit edges with use. Caps remain crisp; elasticated gussets show compression marks over time.
